---
title: "About"
---

Ireland by Numbers is a free website that brings together official statistics about Ireland and presents them as clear, interactive charts and maps. It is a non-partisan, non-profit project, independent of government and of any political party, and its aim is to make the facts about Ireland easier to find and understand.

## Who built it

Ireland by Numbers was built by [Maedbh King](https://www.maedbhking.com/home), with Claude Code helping to develop the charting tools and data updates. It is done in her own time and is independent of her employer. The idea comes from [UK by Numbers](https://ukbynumbers.org) by Hannah Ritchie, which does the same for the UK, and the site owes its approach to that project.

## Funding

The project has no funding.

## Updates

Charts are updated when their sources publish new figures, and new topics are added over time.

## Reusing the charts

Every chart has its own page, and can be downloaded as a PNG or embedded on another website. Charts are licensed [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), so they can be reused for any purpose with credit to Ireland by Numbers and to the original source.

## Reusing the data

The data behind every chart can be downloaded as a CSV. Each chart names its source, with notes on definitions and changes in method. When reusing the data, please cite the original source and check its licence. More on the sources is on the [Data and code](data.qmd) page.

## Contact {#corrections}

Corrections, suggestions and contributions are welcome by email to [irelandbynumbers@proton.me](mailto:irelandbynumbers@proton.me), or as an [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/irelandbynumbers/irelandbynumbers.ie/issues/new/choose). Corrections are made in the open, and the change history of every page is public.
